extDesc.message: Right-click any QR code on a web page to open its link or copy its text. Decoded locally on your device, nothing is uploaded.

popupUsage.message: Right-click a QR code on any page and choose “Scan QR code & open link”. Links open in a new tab; text is copied to the clipboard.

popupDonateHint.message: If this extension saves you time, consider supporting it.

donateRegion.description: Donate method for this locale: cn = WeChat/Alipay, intl = Ko-fi. Not shown to users.

errNotFoundVisible.message: No QR code found. Make sure the whole code is visible on screen.

errMultiple.message: Several QR codes are on this page and the one you clicked can’t be determined. Refresh the page and try again.

payHint.message: This is a payment QR code. Please scan it with the app on your phone (WeChat / Alipay) — it can’t be opened in a browser.
payHint.description: Shown when the decoded QR is a WeChat/Alipay payment code

wxHint.message: This is a WeChat official account or contact code. It only works inside WeChat on your phone; a desktop browser can’t open it.
wxHint.description: Shown when the decoded QR is a WeChat official account or contact code

appHint.message: This is a {scheme} link that only works in its own app on your phone. A desktop browser can’t open it.
appHint.description: Shown when the decoded QR uses a non-http app scheme. {scheme} is replaced with the scheme name

vcardSaved.description: Contact card saved message. {name} is replaced with the contact name
